Dear Madam
I should like much to get your Christmas tree paper[^1] in for December, and I will try, but it must depend on the reckoning of pages by the printer

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: \'A Christmas Tree at a Workhouse\' MP 3rd series 2 (December 1881) 609-612.
